parameters.name: FuncFilter
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the feature specified by FuncId is enabled.

- **config**: enabled.

- **unconfig**: not enabled.

parameters.name: FuncId
parameters.description: The ID of the feature. To find the ID, search for the feature by name in the [Feature parameters for domain name configurations](~~410622~~) document. For example, the ID of the back-to-origin HOST configuration feature (set\_req\_host\_header) is 18.

parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The query type. The default value is exact\_match. Valid values:

- fuzzy\_match: fuzzy query.

- exact\_match: exact match.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names to return on each page. The default value is 20. Valid values: **1** to **500**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
